description: [PREMIUM — needs an API key: call hl_request_free_key first for a free key, or pay per call via x402] Aggregated positioning of a whale cohort for a coin (or all coins): total long/short size & notional, long/short wallet counts, weighted-average entry, net bias, and change vs 1h/24h ago. Cohort = `cohort` arg or HL_WHALE_ADDRESSES. Analytics only, not investment advice.

coin.description: Restrict to one coin (a HIP-3 coin like 'xyz:XYZ100' reads its own dex); omit for all coins.

dex.description: Perp dex: omit for the main dex, a HIP-3 builder dex name (e.g. 'xyz'), or 'all' for every dex (at most 20 wallets).

topN.description: Max wallets to include from the cohort.

name: hl_whale_positions
title: Aggregate whale positions by coin
